family_matrix.scope: Current production binaries: two native GUI processes per frontend, four shell panes each; real native input, forward/reverse focus, rapid handoff and paused-owner retirement. GTK uses Block here; VTE has the separate 28-case lifecycle suite. Fixed input pacing after pane creation; no injected task, geometry or frame proofs.

runtime_cleanup.scope: Read-only exact private-prefix process hygiene, never retirement/destruction/presentation proof.

limitations: PTY observation is bounded advisory local evidence. Explicit setsid detach, remote namespaces and hostile same-UID races are outside acceptance.
Plain VTE has no verified semantic prompt. Block also retains confirmation whenever strict empty-prompt or executable identity proof is missing.

Confirmed whole-window cleanup and natural exit are tested. Last-tab confirmation, late work during GTK retirement, same-process multiwindow, suspend, actual IME/memory/approval/voice/provider flows need further work.
Full-size fixed-window Cat oracle retains raw palette groups and checks old body regions for residue. It does not certify compact/resized bodies or continuous/physical uniqueness.
Clippy ran all targets with three pre-existing Eva lint classes explicitly exempted; no claim of globally warning-free code. Nix/CI wiring is source-checked, not a performed Nix build or deployment.
C11 trusted presentation, actual external APIs and P7 performance/release remain incomplete. No daily install, commits, publication or external messages.
